mapper.select: SELECT C.CART_NUM, C.BOOK_NUM, C.CART_CNT, C.MEM_EMAIL, C.CART_DATE, B.BOOK_TITLE, B.AUTHOR, B.BOOK_PRICE, B.BOOK_STOCK FROM SHOP_CART C LEFT JOIN SHOP_BOOK B ON C.BOOK_NUM = B.BOOK_NUM WHERE C.MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail} ORDER BY C.CART_DATE DESC
SELECT SUM(B.BOOK_PRICE * C.CART_CNT) AS totalPrice FROM SHOP_CART C INNER JOIN SHOP_BOOK B ON C.BOOK_NUM = B.BOOK_NUM WHERE C.MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail}
